overall_notes: Strong Round 2 retrofit. Pea (1986) on superbug + bug-fixing strategies cited in expanded_walkthrough rationale, framing the wrong-fix trap as the predict-test-revise loop. Three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: random line change -> force precision; B: fixes one breaks another -> drill TEST after every FIX; C: can't articulate -> sentence frame). Buzz's distinctive chant 'FIND it, ALTER it, TEST it -- that's DEBUGGING!' lands as a memorable refrain children chant back 3x at consolidation. NO-MATERIALS children-as-robots option present in differentiation.for_movement_learners ('two children stand side-by-side and execute the buggy code; class spots and fixes the bug live'). STRATEGY COMPARE step (action.steps[6]) is the Level-4 mathematical_authenticity move: pairs share line-edit vs row-rewrite vs full-rewrite, class debates which is most efficient for which bug type. Cross-references Lesson 3 (found bugs) and Lesson 5 (capstone) in the rationale. Worksheet Part 3 (partner bug) is a justified transfer task. All required materials are everyday or explicitly optional. Pair clears the strict bar with all six categories at 4.
